podcast.body: Released in February 1997, about a month after his 50th birthday celebration at Madison Square Garden. Bowie was interested in new dance genres like industrial, techno, jungle, and drum and bass, incorporating them into the album. It sparked debate, with some calling it recycled, while others saw it as Bowie's official recognition of these genres, becoming a fine representation of his later work. "Honestly, Earthling is a good record."

podcast.body: Released just weeks after Bowie's 50th birthday concert, this album featured the single "I'm Afraid of Americans," which gained further attention when Trent Reznor collaborated on a remix. It demonstrated Bowie's determination to keep pace with contemporary sounds, though his 50s ultimately became his quietest artistic period. "On a remix of Bowie's single I'm Afraid of Americans from his 1997 album Earthling."
